inspect_image_fields_scope: Inspect.Image immutableID and Config.Image creationreference are separately typed and retained; both exact across two NEWsnapshots. No crossrepresentation comparison or normalization.
known_owner_anchor_scope: No genuine structured anchor for these44CIDs found in bounded selected sources; ps label strings are not parsed.
label_schema: Explicit {kind:'null',value:null} OR {kind:'map',value:exact string-to-string dict}. Historical/current empty ps display allows only null or empty map without owner anchor; historical nonempty display requires current nonempty display and nonempty map. Both new snapshots require exact kind/value equality; no old full-map equality claimed.
scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
